notes.title: Like a Dragon: Ishin! 1.04 Patch Update
notes.content:
Hello RGG Fans!

Thank you for playing Like a Dragon: Ishin!
Patch 1.04 is now live with the following fixes and improvements:

Issues caused by Kijin-maru Kunishige
The following issues will occur when seven seals are set (all slots are filled) on Kijin-maru Kunishige:
[olist]
[*] All seals set on the Kijin-maru Kunishige will change to the first set seal
[*] The item placed next to Kijin-maru Kunishige will change to another item
[*] Depending on the item it changes to, the game may crash when the Equipment menu is opened
[/olist]

We have been investigating ways to fix the issue, but have discovered that some of the changed items cannot be restored due to technical issues.
In addition to fixing the problem, the following measures will be taken to apologize to those affected.
DLC weapons and Remunerative Materials Kit items can be picked up from Bakumatsu Bob, in the kitchen on the first floor of Teradaya.

[list]
[*] Lost DLC weapons can now be re-obtained from Bakumatsu Bob.
[*] Weapons: Bloody Sheen, Bonechewer, Waterdrop, Snowcap, Poet Immortal, Dragon's Clutch
[/list]
[list]
[*] Weapons that can be used without modification will retain their status.
[*] Weapons: Kijin-maru Kunishige and seven seals of altered states, all other weapons.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Certain elements that cannot be restored.
[*] Seals set on the Kijin-maru Kunishige that were changed due to the glitch cannot be restored.
[*] Weapons that have been transformed into other items, as well as the seals that were set on that weapon, cannot be restored.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Replaced incorrect items changed or generated by defects with Bundle Blades.
[/list]

Compensation Items
Items will be distributed to all customers who have installed the digital version pre-order bonus (Japanese Swords & Cannon Set).

Remunerative Materials Kit:	
Sphere Seal: Kiwami x10 
Sphere Seal: Greed x10 

Balance Adjustments
[list]
[*] Increased enemy item drop rates.
[*] The following hard-to-obtain seals are now dropped directly in battle dungeons:
[/list]
	- Sphere Seal: Greed
	- Sphere Seal: Drunken Craze
	- Sword Seal: Fierce Deity
	- Square Seal: Heavy Drinker
	- Square Seal: Reverence
	- Square Seal: Virtuous
	- Square Seal: Special Moves
[list]
[*] Weakened elemental attributes of weapons thrown by giant bosses.
[*] Adjusted difficulty of Ichizu Samurai (Truehearted Samurai) in the singing bar.
[*] Reduced time needed to open pots.
[/list]

Other bug fixes and improvements
Fixed an issue in which, on rare occasions, the screen may flicker, and characters and parts of the background may not be displayed during event scenes.
Fixed an issue where, when performing certain actions during training with William Bradley, the player may be returned to the title screen after a battle or may not receive reward items.
Fixed an issue where a character stuck in the well of the Shinsengumi Barracks can move after saving and loading.
Fixed an issue where the character may not be able to run properly during chases.
Fixed an issue where Komaki Cat-Like Reflexes did not activate in all styles.
Fixed a boss-specific issue where small weapons would sometimes float in mid-air during battle.
Fixed an issue where the Reputation Rakugai message may remain onscreen.
Fixed a display bug when ending a Mahjong game.
Fixed an issue where dummy troopers were displayed when a trooper could not be obtained.
Fixed an issue where map behavior changed depending on frame rate.
Improved behavior when the display mode is set to Borderless.
Improved behavior when the Simplify Combo Attacks accessibility function is set to Press and hold.
Other improvements and bug fixes.

We appreciate your support and patience while our team addresses these known issues.

Please continue to share any bugs you encounter via the Official Bug Thread.

- RGG Community Team -

notes.title: Known Issue - Kijin-maru Kunishige Weapon
notes.content:
Hello RGG Fans! 

Thank you for playing Like a Dragon: Ishin! 

We’re aware of an issue with the Kijin-maru Kunishige included in the digital version pre-order bonus Japanese Swords & Cannon Set and are currently investigating the issue and evaluating methods to fix it.  


Issues caused by Kijin-maru Kunishige: 

The following issue will occur when seven seals are set (filling out all slots) on Kijin-maru Kunishige. 

[olist]
[*] All seals set on Kijin-maru Kunishige will change to the first set seal 
[*] The item placed next to Kijin-maru Kunishige will change to another item 
[*] Depending on the changed item, the game may crash when the Equipment menu is opened 
[/olist]

 
For customers who have purchased the Kijin-maru Kunishige, we kindly ask the following: 

Please do not set the seventh seal (i.e. do not fill all the slots) on the Kijin-maru Kunishige until the patch is delivered. 

If you have already set the seventh seal and the item has changed, please consider the following steps: 

[olist]
[*] Do not change the seal on the Kijin-maru Kunishige, and please wait for the patch to be delivered. 
[*] Load a save file created before setting the seventh seal. 
[/olist]

 
If you have the Kijin-maru Kunishige, we appreciate your understanding and cooperation. 

In addition, the team is currently working on the next patch that includes bug fixes and balance adjustments, which we plan to release soon. 

We appreciate your support and patience while our team addresses these known issues. 

 
Please continue to share any bugs you encounter via the Official Bug Thread. 

 
Thank you for playing! 

- RGG Community Team -

notes.title: Issue of DLC not displaying on Steam
notes.content:
Hello RGG Fans!

Thank you for playing the Like a Dragon: Ishin!.
We have confirmed that some purchasable DLC may not be displayed on Steam, and the team is currently investigating this issue.

[list]
[*] Ryoma Growth Support Kit
[*] Sword Upgrade Materials Kit
[*] Gun Upgrade Materials Kit
[*] Third Division Armament Expansion Kit
[/list]

If you are experiencing this issue, please check your Steam "Inventory" for any DLC that is not listed.
*Inventory is located under the "Your Account Name" menu at the top of the Steam menu bar, to the right of Store, Library, and Community.
*The number of purchasable DLC in your possession will decrease after you retrieve them, but the check mark will not be displayed.
*DLC is only saved in the save data at the time of receipt.
DLC may display correctly after the following:

[list]
[*] Talk to Bakumatsu Bob a few times
[*] Retrieve any other DLC you are eligible to receive
[*] Restart the game
[/list]

In addition, an issue has been identified where talking to Bakumatsu Bob while offline causes him to become stuck. Please ensure that you are online to receive the DLC.

We appreciate your support and patience while our team looks into these known issues.
Please continue to share any bugs you encounter via the Official Bug Thread.

- RGG Community Team -

notes.title: How To Access Pre-order Bonus/DLC
notes.content:
Hello RGG Fans!

In order to access your Pre-order Bonus/DLC, we’ve put together a step-by-step guide to help you get started:

Complete Chapter 1 / Begin Chapter 2

Go downstairs to the first floor. Before leaving the Teradaya Inn, make your way left to explore more of the inn. 
Make sure not to walk to the right because it will trigger a cutscene for the story.

Take a right into the second room. Once inside, exit the room from the other side to the hallway and turn left. You will meet a man named Bakumatsu Bob where you’ll be able to redeem the pre-order bonus and as well as purchase DLC content.

We hope you’re enjoying the game so far!

- RGG Community Team -
